thread:
anya: Quick sync — I'm drafting the non-functional acceptance checklist we need to lock for GA (SLA, docs, support runbook, monitoring, pricing). Putting a compact proposal below. Please call out missing items, owners, and measurable thresholds. If you agree, react :thumbsup: and add owner in-thread.

sam: SGTM. Can you include latency p95 targets by model class? we need clear fallbacks.

anya: Yep. Proposal (very terse):
```
1) SLA (customer-facing):
  - Availability: 99.95% monthly uptime (prod region). Owner: vikram
  - Latency: p95 <= 1200ms for small models, <= 2500ms for medium, <= 5000ms for large (streaming excluded). Owner: sam
  - Error budget and rollback: 0.05% downtime -> auto escalation to oncall + customer comms. Owner: ops (jordyn)

2) Support & runbooks:
  - Oncall playbook covering: degraded latency, model OOM, cache corruption, quota exhaustion. Owner: elaine
  - SLA-exception request flow documented + templated email/FAQ. Owner: product-ops (anya)

3) Docs readiness:
  - Quickstart: end-to-end example + known limits (tokens/seq). Owner: sam
  - Troubleshooting page: top 5 user-visible errors + mitigation. Owner: elaine
  - Migration notes: mapping hosted -> dedicated -> private. Owner: vikram

4) Monitoring & alerting:
  - Telemetry: per-route p50/p95/p99, error rate, queue lengths, GPU util by pool. Owner: eng-sre (jordyn)
  - Alerts: p95 latency breach >3min, error rate spike >0.5% absolute within 5m. Pager for sev2/1. Owner: eng-oncall
  - Observability retention for GA: 30d metrics, 90d logs. Owner: eng-infra

5) Pricing / billing readiness:
  - Pricing doc with example invoices + unit economics for 3 workload archetypes. Owner: finance (sam)
  - Quota defaults + self-serve uplift flow documented. Owner: product-ops (anya)

6) Release controls:
  - Canary criteria: zero new 5xxs, no p95 spike >20% on canary traffic. Owner: eng-platform
  - Rollback plan: automated traffic split back to previous model if error budget exceeded. Owner: eng-runtime

Acceptance: each item needs a short PR/MD + owner + verification steps.
```

vikram: Couple notes — large model p95 = 5s seems aggressive for some customer SLAs, but OK as baseline if we have clear config to opt into higher perf (dedicated). Also add "data residency" docs item for private deployments.

elaine: I can draft the runbook skeleton. Suggest we add a postmortem play for model drift detection alerts (owner eng-ml).

jordyn: Monitoring owners — we need to confirm retention feasibility with infra. I'll ping infra after this thread. Also recommend we add an SLI for prefix cache hit-rate (cost-sensitive).

sam: On pricing examples — I'll add 3 archetypes: bursty chat, steady embedding, high-throughput batch. Want to ensure unit costs with and without KV cache shown.

anya: Nice. Action items I captured:
- vikram -> add data residency doc stub + sample config (due EOD Thu)
- sam -> pricing archetypes + sample invoices (due Tue)
- elaine -> runbook + troubleshooting page skeleton (due Mon)
- jordyn -> confirm retention and add prefix-cache SLI (due Wed)
- eng-platform -> canary gating checklist (assign in jira)
- eng-runtime -> rollback automation spec (assign in jira)

sam: +1 to those owners. Can we create a single checklist MD in the repo so QA can sign off?

anya: Yes — I'll create a repo PR that references all items and links tasks. ops-bot, please create a tracking ticket for GA non-functional acceptance and link to these owners.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1427: "GA non-functional acceptance checklist" — owners assigned as comments. Link: https://tracker.example/INFRA-1427

vika (vikram): :thumbsup: moving to sendables.

jordyn: I'll follow up on infra constraints and update ticket.

anya: Thanks everyone — this is the last pass before we convert into the formal launch criteria doc. If you want different thresholds, call them out here within 24h. Otherwise I'll merge the checklist and mark for QA validation. :rocket:
